principles: Written from golden_decision and golden_reason in mannual_label.json, for the 18 cancellation tasks of the midway experiment. grade_reasons.py grades each simulation against it.
One request per customer request that needs a decision. Pure information requests (the upcoming-trip total in task 7) are left to COMMUNICATE.

outcome is the decision the agent must tell the customer. also_accepted lists other outcomes only where docs/golden_labels.md records the label as ambiguous: transferring flown reservation NQNU5R in tasks 9 and 37.

elements are the facts the agent's reason must contain. A denied cancellation must show that each allowing condition the reservation's own record could meet does not hold: booking time (24 hours), cabin (business) and insurance (with a covered reason). The airline-cancellation condition is required only when a cancellation, delay or schedule change comes up in the conversation, because the customer already knows whether the airline cancelled their flight.

When the customer makes a false claim about a fact (booking time, insurance), the element states the true fact. An approved request needs the condition that allows it and the amounts the customer pays or receives when the label gives them, not the rules that merely permit the transaction.

must_not lists customer arguments that are not policy conditions (a claimed earlier approval, membership, hardship, insurance on another trip). The agent need not rebut them but must not accept them as grounds.
Dates, flight numbers and exact wording are not required unless the element says so.

Task 39 follows its label (deny MSJ4OA), which the answer key contradicts, so no agent can pass both DB and REASON on it. Tasks 9, 37 and 39 are graded but reported apart (excluded_from_scoring in mannual_label.json).

conditions.airline_disruption: a flight cancellation, delay or schedule change by the airline comes up in the conversation, raised by the customer or by the agent
conditions.cancel_anyway: the customer asks to cancel even without a refund
